pose: TALL_MEASURE framing. The Zhejiangopterus is in a tall quadrupedal stance. Its long, slender neck and toothless beak reach the top 5% of the frame. The sharp, pointed wing-finger joints are tucked high, emphasizing verticality.

environmental_details.ground: Dark organic mudstone and grey siltstone.
environmental_details.flora: Distant broad-leafed Mesozoic trees in a hazy, humid background.
